name: WeChat/QQ Alert
author: xiyeming
description: Blinks the original tray icon in place when a WeChat/QQ notification arrives; falls back to a standalone alert icon; clears on focus

barWidget.description: Blinks the app's own tray icon in place (Windows-taskbar style) when a notification arrives, with a standalone-icon fallback — WeChat/QQ for Linux never signal tray attention
